data.narrative:
EdgeRunner AI, a Series A defense and security company founded by Tyler Xuan Saltsman and Colton Malkerson, has raised $17.5M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI, all at Series A stage within Defense & Security.

Two methods triangulate valuation. Stage-progression, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $18M raised proxy, implies $35M. Peer-median analysis across the four primary comparable companies yields $700M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The wide dispersion reflects material heterogeneity in defense-tech valuations at this stage, likely reflecting differences in customer traction, IP differentiation, and customer concentration risk.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $30M to $805M, with a median of $368M. Stage-progression yields the floor; peer-median anchors the upper bound. The gap between methods is substantial and reflects uncertainty inherent to early-stage defense funding, where customer relationships and contract pipeline visibility materially drive valuation floors above pure capital-raised multiples. Key unknowns include EdgeRunner's customer concentration, contract duration, and technical differentiation relative to the peer set.
